steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates said Meta was unique in using its market power and 3.5 billion users to copy rival features and overwhelm competitors.

episode.title: Meta copies another product, we’re beating the market & the chase for Warren Buffett continues

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates noted Meta’s Quest 2 headset surpassed Microsoft Xbox Series X and S lifetime sales and was closing in on PlayStation 5, showing real traction.

episode.title: What ever happened to the Metaverse?

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates explained Meta’s advertising platform turned Facebook into a profitable business by 2010 and underpinned its 2012 IPO, showing strong product-market fit for advertisers.

episode.title: Leaning Out: Sheryl Sandberg logs off Facebook

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates argued Meta’s ability to leverage its 3.5 billion users to replicate competitors’ products gave it unusual power to defend profits.

episode.title: Meta copies another product, we’re beating the market & the chase for Warren Buffett continues

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates highlighted Facebook and Google’s digital ad share falling from about 60 percent in 2019 to the low 50s as Amazon’s advertising business grew rapidly.

episode.title: Carbon capture, Google & Facebooks ad duopoly and where are Bryce and Alec investing?

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In June 2026, Equity Mates described Meta’s habit of launching copycat products and said its balance sheet and highly profitable core let it keep funding new bets.

episode.title: Meta copies another product, we’re beating the market & the chase for Warren Buffett continues

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates reported Meta had spent about $36 billion on the metaverse since 2019 and planned to hire 10,000 people in Europe, signalling heavy reinvestment.

episode.title: What ever happened to the Metaverse?

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates said Meta’s pivot toward metaverse hardware marked a shift in capital allocation as its ads engine faced privacy changes and a maturing era.
